entries.subject: form-assistant
entries.title: Required fields first
entries.text: When risk insight is requested, prioritize missing required fields and blockers before optional details.

entries.subject: form-assistant
entries.title: Tone guidance
entries.text: Rewrite suggestions should stay concise, actionable, and user-friendly with no jargon.

entries.subject: smart-table
entries.title: Operational analysis format
entries.text: Table insights should always provide trend, risk/anomaly, and recommended next action.

entries.subject: smart-table
entries.title: Sort preference
entries.text: Prefer sorting by urgency, due date, or severity columns when available.

entries.subject: sprint-planner
entries.title: Sprint priority policy
entries.text: High priority items due within 48 hours should be surfaced as top focus.

entries.subject: sprint-planner
entries.title: Communication standard
entries.text: Summaries should support standups: what is done, at risk, and the immediate next step.
